content: Nkwuri s'etzirakpo
Wa Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Rọhng ka Phero, atza agbaakh-ẹ bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'abaHiburu obeni bi, ‘Tte anọng paam ọbọhk bẹ afona, ifha bẹ atza akpobh-m.
Idikha abhumi bi atte bẹ ọbọhk, achin ororo abọkha bẹ ahok,
kaam Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ńgọhkha bọng nkwuri s'ideden k'etzirakpo py'ewobh k'owoni, py'ede: nnyanyaang, ọmaana abhaam, ọmaana akamẹl, ọmaana andaamogbodo, ọmaana arukhimaan ttara avu.
Yina, kaam Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ńgọmi etzirakpo py'anọng p'Israẹl ewobha, k'etzirakpo py'anọng p'Ijip. Otzirattọhk manda vani f'anọng p'Israẹl kópe.’ ”
Mando kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okhe ogbe, oben bi, “Ophyini wọ kwa kaam Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ńsi odik nwa m'irek nna.”
Ewu ehobh mẹ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi mach'obeni. Etzirakpo py'anọng p'Ijip epe biphyir, yina, otzirattọhk manda vani f'anọng p'Israẹl f'ope kode.

Mẹ wọ ofon, Phero ọtzọhm ajinọng bani bẹ atza adọhn odik nwa, bẹ are bi, ode odik-ọkka bi, otzirattọhk manda vani f'anọng p'Israẹl f'ọkk'ọpa, kode. Kaambi mẹ wọ, Phero ochina ororo ọgaangi eho, obhum bi, otte anọng p'Israẹl ọbọhk bẹ afona.
Nkwuri s'aphyi
Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn bi, “Bọng kpokhi ọtzọtzọhng-khọhma ka nkwukha ka mbọhkpattem sabọng, tte Mosẹs okwuri ọtzọtzọhng-khọhma nwa k'iwokhi, Phero obe mẹ ore.
Itzọtzọhng nna íyaami mach'ọkpọm makhọra irerek s'Ijip, sẹ ín-itzima aphyi p'anwa ibhan ikwu, p'asi anọngeya, ọmaana nden makhọra irek nna.”
Mẹ wọ, bẹ akpokhi ọtzọtzọhng-khọhma ka nkwukha, akwu abe Phero k'itzitzikha. Mosẹs ọtzọkha sẹ okwuri k'iwokhi, aphyi p'anwa ibhan abhona anọngẹya ọmaana etzirakpo bi wooii.
Wa anọng p'am-asi mbọhng, bẹ Mosẹs k'itzitzikha kafha abe, okhuri aphyi p'asi bẹ, ọmaana anọng p'Ijip biphyir.
Yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi Phero odo eho ọgaangi, itzọhng koyong ọnang Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn, mach'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'Mosẹs ọgbaakha.
Nkwuri s'arọngda

Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Mosẹs bi, “Bina atza akwunga Phero okpebhamma, aben-ẹ bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'abaHiburu obeni bi, ‘Tte anọng paam ọbọhk bẹ afona, ifha bẹ atza akpobh-m.
Oni mando ode, m'ogbe nwa, kaam nna ngọhkha kọ ọmaana akhaan-nọng pọ nkwuri s'ideden, ifha kọ aronga bi, ọnọng kw'ode macha kaam, makhọra ọyagbin, kode.
Ọban bi, nnamanda ira nkk'ettuma ndọhma nnang kọ ọmaana anọng pọ, ttara nkwuri s'ira nkk'bọng ifha, mbiri ndimi bọng m'ọyagbin.
Yina, odik kw'osi nttọ-ọ ọbọhk, awobha akpen ode bi, ifha are ẹfa chaam, ọmaana bi, bẹ afha asi ẹjaakhi cha che chaam makhọra ọyagbin.
Kọ atzima am-age-oge anang anọng paam bi, atte bẹ ọbọhk, bẹ afona.
Mẹ wọ, ophyini k'ogbe-dema nwa, kaam ndebh arọngda p'apyibhi ọtzam ayọhnga arọngda p'akk'atta ttẹwọr kẹ da Ijip ọmaan maa, apyiri ma.
Tzọhm ẹkkaabha bẹ atzima etzirakpo pyọ, ọmaana ọttọhk kpenamkpen fọ f'owobh k'owoni atzima adim k'ikhira, okhuri bi, arọngda mba atzebhi, anọngeya ọmaana etzirakpo py'eni k'ikhira ewobh, épe-ope.’ ”
Mẹ wọ, akhaan-nọng pa Phero p'akhaam ojora f'atzim p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, afona m'ẹbhar-ẹbhar atza atzọkha atzọhmnọng pabẹ, ọmaana etzirakpo pyabẹ, atzima adim k'ẹtzaanga.
Yina, ayok mbuma p'asi itzimabhaang k'atzim p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, atte atzọhmnọng pabẹ, ọmaana etzirakpo pyabẹ ọbọhk k'owoni.
Mẹ wọ e, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi on-oben Mosẹs bi, “Nemi ọbọhk kwọ atzena k'ẹrọng, ifha arọngda atzebh anọngeya ọmaana etzirakpo, ttara ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'omeni k'iwoni s'anọng p'Ijip.”
Mada Mosẹs onemi ochikhura kwẹ otzena k'ẹrọng, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọtzọhm ẹbhaangkpon ọmaana arọngda, ẹbhaangkpon ẹmani k'irek. Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi otzebh arọngda k'obhon kw'Ijip.
Arọngda atzebh, ẹbhaangkpon ẹmani edimi, ẹmani edimi, arọngda mba bọ iwa apyibhi ọtzam ayọhnga p'akk'atta ttẹwọr kẹ da Ijip ọmaan maa, okwu ode obhon.
Arọngda mba afhu anọngẹya ọmaana etzirakpo k'Ijip, ọmaana nchi ttara ọttọhk kpenamkpen f'omeni k'iwoni.
Ibẹ ibungisẹ s'iwa arọngda mba an-atzebhi ide ka Goshẹn, kẹ da iwa anọng p'Israẹl arukhi.
Mando kwa Phero oyeri Mosẹs ọmaana Aarọn ọgbaak bẹ bi, “Kaam nkk'ẹkhọhngkwuri nsa m'ogbe nwa, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi wọ otzor-otzor, kaam ọmaana anọng paam bọ mọkhaam ottotto.
Bọng zi njọhm anang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, ọkwọbha ẹbhaangkpon ttara arọngda, kkeri py'ẹkk'ẹhaabha kpọng. Kaam ńtte bọng ọbọhk otte bọng afona, bọng kakhaambi, abira achina ororo awobha ma.”

Mosẹs obhin-ẹ bi, “Idikha nkk'obhon ọbọhk ntta mfona, kaam ḿmẹma mbọhk saam ńzi njọhm nang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, mmaangkpon ńkwọbha ọtta-ọtta, arọngda abira ákwọbha otzetzebh. Mẹ kw'atzima aronga bi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi wọ ọkhaam ọyagbin.
Yina, kaam nnong kẹ bi, kọ ọmaana akhaan-nọng pọ, ojora f'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ibinọkpaabyi atzima am-akhaama.”
(Wa ngwugwuma ọmaana abarli akhibhi, da iwa abarli akk'akhora, ngwugwuma mbiri nwọm.
Yina, awit kàkhibhi okhuri da iwa bẹ ani akhori m'ogbe nwa).
Mando kwa Mosẹs obin oji Phero, otte obhon ọbọhk, ọtza ọmẹma mbọhk otzena Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ozi njọhm, mmaangkpon nkwọbha ọtta-ọtta, arọngda akwọbha ottotto, ẹrọng ebire ẹkwọbha otzetzebh.
Mada Phero ore bi ẹrọng, ọmaana arọngda, ttara mmaangkpon ikk'ikwọbha, obiro osi ẹkhọngkwuri. Kẹ ttara akhaan-nọng pẹ abira achina ororo agaangi eho.
Mẹ wọ e, Phero ochina ororo ọbar ettem, anọng p'Israẹl ọbọhk kokher otte bẹ afona, mach'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'Mosẹs otzima ọgbaak.
